description: Weekly grouped updates, never automerged: `npm run build` does not catch rendering regressions (syntax highlighting above all), so frontend bumps get a look in `npm run dev` before merge.

packageRules.description: Node: even majors only; odd majors never become LTS.
Terraform providers stay on the lockfile's exact versions until the AWS provider 6.x upgrade, which is gated on clean before/after plans and lifts this rule.
Same reason: lockfile maintenance would bump the providers within their constraints.
